# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). In short: be kind, assume good faith, stay on topic, and don't harass anyone.

To report a problem, use **Report content** on the comment and send it to the repository's maintainers. They may hide comments, lock threads, and block accounts that break these rules, including accounts that post unattended AI output.
